fix(editor): ignore deleted elements when inserting frame children (#12510)

fix(editor): place new frame children below the frame despite deleted children

Deleted frame children keep their frameId and index, so one left above the
frame made new children of that frame (created or dragged in) go above it,
up to the top of the canvas, until a reload dropped the deleted elements.
Only live children count now.
